title: Record disposition
purpose: Record a reasoned disposition for one current QC failure, missing measurement or frequency shortfall in an analytical or preparation batch.
summary: Record a reasoned decision on one current QC finding: a failure, a missing measurement or a frequency shortfall. Analysts and reviewers can record; only a reviewer can accept.

tasks.title: Decide on a QC finding
steps: Read the finding at the top of the page.
Choose the [[Disposition]] and explain it in [[Corrective action or reason]].

tasks.title: Leave without deciding
steps: Select [[Cancel]] to return to the batch.

good_to_know: Only Accept data with qualification releases the hold, and only for this finding.
You cannot accept QC you measured, or a finding that affects results you entered or submitted.
A decision applies to the finding as it is now. If the QC, its limits or the batch counts change, decide again.
Every decision is kept, and the latest one governs.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Analysts and reviewers can open this page and record a disposition; other staff roles and client accounts are refused, and read the finding and its decisions on the batch and review pages instead. Administrators also have operational analyst and reviewer access, but independence rules still apply. Superuser status alone does not grant an application role.

sections.title: Finding and scope
paragraphs: The warning identifies exactly which current finding this disposition concerns. Enter through Record disposition on the owning batch or review page. A changed or nonexistent target cannot be decided from this page; reload the batch and open the current finding. Breadcrumbs and Cancel follow the owning batch type.

items.label: Disposition
items.description: Required choice: Accept data with qualification, Reanalysis required or Reject affected data.

items.label: Corrective action or reason
items.description: Required nonblank explanation of the corrective action/evidence and why this disposition is appropriate. Retained with the actor and time.

items.label: Accept data with qualification
items.description: Only a reviewer can accept. Acceptance resolves this finding’s hold only. You cannot accept QC you measured, or a finding affecting results you entered or submitted, including historical revisions. Having analyst and reviewer roles does not bypass this rule.

items.label: Reanalysis required
items.description: An analyst or reviewer may record this decision. The finding continues to hold approval.

items.label: Reject affected data
items.description: An analyst or reviewer may record this decision. The finding continues to hold approval.

items.label: Current context
items.description: A disposition is tied to the current finding, including relevant measurement, evaluated limits and frequency/count context. Changes can require a fresh decision. An earlier acceptance can cease to count if the accepting person later enters or submits affected work.

items.label: Record disposition
items.description: Write a new attributed disposition and audit event. Latest disposition for the same finding governs; previous decisions are preserved. The service rechecks the current finding and independence before saving.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Return to the batch without a new decision.

sections.title: History and errors
paragraphs: History lists all recorded dispositions for this exact finding oldest first, with disposition, time, actor and reason. A later rejection or reanalysis supersedes an earlier acceptance. Invalid input remains on the page; if the QC or membership context changed, reopen the current finding rather than retrying an obsolete target.
